dimensions.label: Magnitude values on locus
dimensions.definition: num_mag_values: number of magnitude values recorded on the ANTARES locus (alert multiplicity proxy).
qualifications: Legacy repository sample; not a V3 published build.

dimensions.label: Brightest alert magnitude
dimensions.definition: brightest_alert_magnitude: brightest magnitude among the locus alerts (survey/band mix as stored by ANTARES).
qualifications: 106 demo values were clipped by the legacy exporter and are null here.
Band and survey of the brightest alert are not carried in this basis.

dimensions.label: Newest alert time
dimensions.definition: newest_alert_observation_time as exported; MJD treated as UTC by the historical exporter.
qualifications: Synthesized by the legacy demo exporter (hash-derived); not the ANTARES value.

dimensions.label: Galactic latitude b
dimensions.definition: Galactic latitude of the native entity position (ICRS -> Galactic, Astropy/Hipparcos rotation).

dimensions.label: Ecliptic latitude β
dimensions.definition: Mean ecliptic latitude of J2000.0 of the native entity position (ICRS frame bias ignored).

dimensions.label: Alert time baseline
dimensions.definition: Newest minus oldest alert time on the locus.
dimensions.unavailable_reason: Oldest-alert time is not in this basis, and the demo newest-alert time is synthetic.

dimensions.label: Colour
dimensions.unavailable_reason: No per-band photometry is exported for ANTARES loci in this basis.

dimensions.label: Variability statistics (χ², skewness, …)
dimensions.unavailable_reason: ANTARES lc_feature_extractor values are not exported in this basis; the lc_feature_extractor tag marks filter membership only.

dimensions.label: Classifier scores
dimensions.definition: Model outputs attached to the locus.
dimensions.unavailable_reason: ANTARES tags are filter memberships, not model scores; no classifier outputs are exported in this basis.
